overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged: the July 3, 2024 executive session fit Purpose 2. It separately reminded the Board to name a statutory purpose in notice and open-session announcements.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board entered executive session for an improper purpose at its July 3, 2024 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that these discussions fit within the parameters of executive session Purpose 2, as the discussions related to strategy in preparation for contract negotiations.

allegations.summary: Notice listed an appropriation-transfer executive session item without naming a statutory purpose; AG raised this on its own, not in the complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Although the notice explained the anticipated discussion, the language alone did not provide any indication or description of the specific executive session purpose.
